hippocampus_threshold.name: Hippocampus trigger threshold
hippocampus_threshold.hint: Number of accumulated user/assistant chunks per session that trigger a background hippocampus run (fact extraction, deduplication, reflection, profile update). Lower = more responsive memory but more LLM calls.

zh.name: 海马体触发阈值
zh.hint: 每个会话累计多少条 user/assistant 对话块时触发一次后台海马体运行（提取事实、去重、反思、更新画像）。值越低记忆越实时但 LLM 调用越多。

llm_chat_timeout.name: Hippocampus LLM call timeout (seconds)
llm_chat_timeout.hint: Per-call timeout for every LLM request made by the hippocampus pipeline (fact extraction, dedup conflict check, merge, reflection, etc.). On timeout the call is treated as failure and the batch is re-buffered for the next attempt — no data loss, just a retry. Raise this if your LLM provider is slow or you see frequent 'extraction timed out' warnings; lower it if you run a local fast model and want quicker failover.

zh.name: 海马体 LLM 调用超时（秒）
zh.hint: 海马体流水线每条 LLM 请求的超时时间（提取事实、去重冲突判定、合并、反思等都受这个限制）。超时算作失败，该批次会被重新放回 pending 队列等下一次触发——不会丢数据，只是重试。LLM provider 慢或日志里频繁出现 'extraction timed out' 时调大；本地快模型可以调小做快速失败。

extraction_model.name: Extraction Model
extraction_model.hint: Model used for fact extraction, conflict detection, and merge operations. Leave empty to use the default fast LLM.

zh.name: 提取模型
zh.hint: 用于事实提取、去重冲突判定、合并操作的模型 ID。留空使用默认快速 LLM。

reflection_model.name: Reflection Model
reflection_model.hint: Model used for high-level reflection generation and profile compaction. Leave empty to use the default LLM.

zh.name: 反思模型
zh.hint: 用于升维反思生成、画像压实的模型 ID。留空使用默认 LLM。

recall_top_k.name: Recall top-K
recall_top_k.hint: How many long-term memories to recall and inject into the system prompt each turn.

zh.name: 召回条数 K
zh.hint: 每轮对话从长期记忆里召回多少条注入到 system prompt。

max_memory_length.name: Short-term memory window
max_memory_length.hint: Sliding-window size for short-term chat history (chunks per session).

zh.name: 短期记忆窗口
zh.hint: 短期对话历史的滑动窗口大小（每会话保留多少对话块）。

inject_profile.name: Inject user profile
inject_profile.hint: Inject the per-user profile (name, traits, preferences, relationships, facts) into the system prompt every turn.

zh.name: 注入用户画像
zh.hint: 每轮对话把当前用户的画像（名字、特征、偏好、关系、事实）注入到 system prompt。

inject_facts.name: Inject recalled facts
inject_facts.hint: Include recalled fact memories in the system prompt every turn.

zh.name: 注入召回的事实
zh.hint: 每轮对话把召回的事实类记忆注入到 system prompt。

inject_reflections.name: Inject recalled reflections
inject_reflections.hint: Include recalled high-level reflections in the system prompt every turn.

zh.name: 注入召回的洞察
zh.hint: 每轮对话把召回的高层洞察（reflection）注入到 system prompt。

enable_decay.name: Enable forgetting (decay)
enable_decay.hint: Periodically downgrade and archive low-importance, long-unused memories. (Decay runs on demand via run_forgetting_cycle; scheduling will be added in a later release.)

zh.name: 启用遗忘（衰减）
zh.hint: 周期性降级并归档低重要度、长期未访问的记忆。（当前需手动调用 run_forgetting_cycle 触发，后续版本会加自动调度。）

auto_migrate_legacy_db.name: Auto-migrate v2 SQLite + hippocampus plugin
auto_migrate_legacy_db.hint: On first run, automatically migrate any existing v2 kiraos.db (user_profiles + event_logs) and kira_plugin_hippocampus_memory data into the unified TOML structure. The old kiraos.db is backed up to kiraos.db.bak_<timestamp>; hippocampus data remains untouched (read-only import) and the plugin is auto-disabled.

zh.name: 自动迁移 v2 SQLite + 海马体插件
zh.hint: 首次启动时自动把已存在的 v2 kiraos.db（user_profiles + event_logs 两张表）和 kira_plugin_hippocampus_memory 的数据迁移到统一的 TOML 结构。旧 kiraos.db 会备份为 kiraos.db.bak_<时间戳>；海马体插件的数据保持不动（只读导入）且插件会被自动禁用。

max_recall_chars.name: Max recall block chars
max_recall_chars.hint: Truncate the injected recall block to N characters before injecting into the system prompt. Prevents excessive context pollution when many long memories are recalled.

zh.name: 召回文本最大长度
zh.hint: 注入到 system prompt 前截断召回块的字符数。防止召回过多长记忆时污染上下文。

reflection_threshold.name: Reflection trigger (facts per entity)
reflection_threshold.hint: Generate a high-level reflection once an entity has accumulated at least this many facts. Reflections synthesize patterns across facts.

zh.name: 升维反思阈值（每实体 fact 数）
zh.hint: 每个实体累积到这么多条 fact 后生成一条高层 reflection。Reflection 会从 facts 中综合出模式和洞察。

profile_compact_threshold.name: Profile compact trigger (facts)
profile_compact_threshold.hint: Compact a profile's facts list into tagged short bullets once it reaches this count. Prevents profile injection from bloating the system prompt. Values below 2 are clamped to 2 at runtime.

zh.name: 画像压实阈值（条数）
zh.hint: 画像 facts 列表达到此条数后，压实为带标签前缀的规范短句。防止画像注入膨胀 system prompt。小于 2 时运行时钳到 2。

profile_compact_max_chars.name: Profile compact trigger (total chars)
profile_compact_max_chars.hint: Compact a profile's facts once their combined length exceeds this many characters (checked alongside the count threshold). Values below 200 are clamped to 200 at runtime.

zh.name: 画像压实阈值（总字符数）
zh.hint: 画像 facts 总字符数超过此值时也会触发压实（与条数阈值任一满足即触发）。小于 200 时运行时钳到 200。

enable_persona_evolution.name: Enable Tier-3 persona leap
enable_persona_evolution.hint: Allow reflections to merge into the bot's core persona (destructive, changes the bot's character over time). Off by default — this is an advanced feature that fundamentally alters the bot's personality based on observed patterns.

zh.name: 启用三级人设跃迁
zh.hint: 允许 Reflection 合并到 Bot 的核心人设（破坏性，会随时间改变 Bot 性格）。默认关闭——这是高级特性，会根据观察到的模式从根本上改变 Bot 的人格。

skills_dir.name: Skills directory
skills_dir.hint: Path to the skills directory (defaults to data/skills/). Each skill is a subfolder containing either SKILL.md (recommended, single-file YAML frontmatter) or the legacy manifest.json + instruction.md pair.

zh.name: 技能目录
zh.hint: 技能目录的路径（默认 data/skills/）。每个技能是一个子目录，可以用 SKILL.md（推荐，YAML frontmatter 单文件）或者老格式的 manifest.json + instruction.md 两文件。

disabled_skills.name: Disabled skills
disabled_skills.hint: List of skill names to disable (won't be registered as LLM tools). Example: ["tarot_reading", "daily_fortune"]

zh.name: 禁用的技能
zh.hint: 要禁用的技能名列表（不会注册为 LLM 工具）。例如：["tarot_reading", "daily_fortune"]

enable_slash_commands.name: Enable slash commands
enable_slash_commands.hint: Allow users to trigger skills via /command (e.g. /tarot). When disabled, skills can only be triggered by LLM.

zh.name: 启用斜杠命令
zh.hint: 允许用户用 /命令 直接触发技能（如 /tarot）。关闭时技能只能由 LLM 调用。

webui_port.name: Memory WebUI port
webui_port.hint: Port for the memory management WebUI (0 = disabled, valid range: 1-65535). Example: 8765

zh.name: 记忆 WebUI 端口
zh.hint: 记忆管理 WebUI 的监听端口（0 = 禁用，有效范围 1-65535）。例如：8765

webui_host.name: Memory WebUI host
webui_host.hint: Bind address for the memory WebUI. Use 127.0.0.1 for local-only access.

zh.name: 记忆 WebUI 绑定地址
zh.hint: 记忆 WebUI 的监听地址。127.0.0.1 表示仅本机可访问。

webui_token.name: Memory WebUI token
webui_token.hint: Access token for the memory WebUI (leave empty for no authentication, only safe for local access).

zh.name: 记忆 WebUI 访问令牌
zh.hint: 记忆 WebUI 的访问令牌（留空表示不鉴权，仅在仅本机访问时安全）。
